# Handoff Template

Use this template when another agent or developer may continue the work.

## Work Completed

- Describe completed changes.
- Include important behavior and design decisions.
- Mention commits or artifact IDs when available.

## Files Touched

- List changed files or generated artifacts.

## Validation

- List commands that passed.
- List manual checks that were performed.
- State checks that could not be run and why.

## Blockers

- List anything that still requires user input or external state.

## Next Steps

- List the next concrete actions in order.
- Include the safest first command or tool call when useful.
